panels.description: All 36 NIDP feeds with schedule (IST), latest run status, freshness gap, and last error. Sorted by problem: FAILED first, then never-run, then PARTIAL, then overdue, then OK by recency. Cron expressions are UTC.

WITH schedule AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('bhavcopy',                    '30 13 * * 1-5',   'IST 19:00 Mon-Fri'),
    ('index_close',                 '30 13 * * 1-5',   'IST 19:00 Mon-Fri'),
    ('fii_dii',                     '0 14 * * 1-5',    'IST 19:30 Mon-Fri'),
    ('bulk_deals',                  '0 14 * * 1-5',    'IST 19:30 Mon-Fri'),
    ('block_deals',                 '0 14 * * 1-5',    'IST 19:30 Mon-Fri'),
    ('fno_bhavcopy',                '0 14 * * 1-5',    'IST 19:30 Mon-Fri'),
    ('delivery',                    '0 5 * * 2-6',     'IST 10:30 Tue-Sat (T+1)'),
    ('corporate_actions',           '30 14 * * *',     'IST 20:00 daily'),
    ('rbi_yields',                  '0 15 * * 1-5',    'IST 20:30 Mon-Fri'),
    ('fred_macro',                  '30 15 * * *',     'IST 21:00 daily'),
    ('nse_calendar',                '30 0 1 * *',      'IST 06:00 day 1'),
    ('index_constituents',          '0 1 1 * *',       'IST 06:30 day 1'),
    ('nse_financials',              '0 15 * * *',      'IST 20:30 daily'),
    ('nse_shareholding',            '30 15 * * *',     'IST 21:00 daily'),
    ('nse_equity_master',           '30 1 * * 0',      'IST 07:00 Sunday'),
    ('price_adjuster',              '0 17 * * 1-5',    'IST 22:30 Mon-Fri'),
    ('snapshot_builder',            '30 16 * * 1-5',   'IST 22:00 Mon-Fri'),
    ('corporate_announcements_nse', '*/10 3-18 * * 1-5','every 10m IST 09-23 Mon-Fri'),
    ('corporate_announcements_bse', '*/10 3-18 * * 1-5','every 10m IST 09-23 Mon-Fri'),
    ('announcement_classifier',     '*/30 * * * *',    'every 30m'),
    ('document_parser',             '*/15 * * * *',    'every 15m'),
    ('amfi_nav',                    '30 14 * * 1-5',   'IST 20:00 Mon-Fri'),
    ('amfi_circulars',              '30 3 * * *',      'IST 09:00 daily'),
    ('mf_disclosure_snapshot',      '30 4 12 * *',     'IST 10:00 day 12'),
    ('mf_holdings',                 '30 5 12 * *',     'IST 11:00 day 12'),
    ('event_calendar',              '0 1,15 * * 1-5',  'IST 06:30 + 20:30 Mon-Fri'),
    ('event_day_poller',            '*/5 3-10 * * 1-5','every 5m IST 09-16 Mon-Fri'),
    ('d1_prep',                     '30 13 * * 1-5',   'IST 19:00 Mon-Fri'),
    ('intelligence',                '30 14 * * 1-5',   'IST 20:00 Mon-Fri'),
    ('quality_gate',                '0 17 * * 1-5',    'IST 22:30 Mon-Fri'),
    ('intelligence_layer',          '45 17 * * 1-5',   'IST 23:15 Mon-Fri'),
    ('portfolio_intelligence_sync', '0 18 * * 1-5',    'IST 23:30 Mon-Fri'),
    ('mf_analytics_engine',         '0 15 * * 1-5',    'IST 20:30 Mon-Fri'),
    ('technical_indicator_engine',  '5 17 * * 1-5',    'IST 22:35 Mon-Fri'),
    ('fundamental_engine',          '35 17 * * 1-5',   'IST 23:05 Mon-Fri'),
    ('mf_derived_refresh',          '20 18 * * 1-5',   'IST 23:50 Mon-Fri')
  ) AS t(ingester, cron_utc, schedule_ist)
),
latest AS (
  SELECT
    ingester,
    last_run_status      AS status,
    last_run_at          AS started_at,
    NULL::timestamptz    AS finished_at,
    NULL::date           AS target_date,
    NULL::text           AS error_message,
    NULL::bigint         AS rows_inserted,
    (last_run_duration_ms / 1000.0) AS duration_s
  FROM nidp.source_registry
  WHERE last_run_status IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  s.ingester,
  s.schedule_ist                                                       AS schedule,
  s.cron_utc                                                           AS cron_utc,
  COALESCE(l.status, 'NEVER')                                          AS last_status,
  l.started_at                                                         AS last_run_at,
  ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - l.started_at))/3600)::numeric, 1) AS hours_since_last_run,
  l.target_date,
  l.rows_inserted,
  ROUND(l.duration_s::numeric, 1)                                      AS last_duration_s,
  LEFT(COALESCE(l.error_message, ''), 300)                             AS last_error
  FROM schedule s
  LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.ingester = s.ingester
 ORDER BY
   CASE WHEN l.status = 'FAILED'         THEN 1
        WHEN l.started_at IS NULL        THEN 2
        WHEN l.status = 'PARTIAL'        THEN 3
        WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - l.started_at))/3600 > 24 THEN 4
        ELSE 5 END,
   l.started_at DESC NULLS LAST

panels.description: Most recent failures and partial successes from nidp.job_log — last 7 days. Full error_message text shown.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ingester,
  status,
  started_at,
  target_date,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at - started_at))::numeric, 1) AS duration_s,
  COALESCE(error_message, '')                                        AS error_message,
  run_id
  FROM nidp.job_log
 WHERE status IN ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL')
   AND started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
 ORDER BY started_at DESC
 LIMIT 100
